# Focus Lab

> Focus Lab is a product studio based in Islamabad, Pakistan. We design, build,
> and run our own software — Urban Events, WorkProof, and Fixer — and
> occasionally partner with a team when the fit is right.

Contact: bilal@focuslab.pk · +92 333 5507394 · Islamabad, Pakistan
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/110646093/

## Products

- [Urban Events](https://urbanevents.pk): Ticketing for Pakistan. Publish an event page, sell tickets in PKR via JazzCash, Easypaisa, and bank transfer, and check guests in by QR. Free for free events; 5% per paid ticket.
- [WorkProof](https://workproof.focuslab.pk): Self-hosted workforce activity analytics with real privacy. Active vs. idle, focus ratio, and per-person rollups; no keystroke or content capture. Pricing on request.
- [Fixer](/products/fixer/): Self-hosted. Watches production logs, reduces them to the exceptions worth a human's time, and opens draft pull requests with a root cause, the evidence, and a proposed fix. A human always reviews and merges — the GitHub App can never merge. Available on request.

## Pages

- [Home / stream](https://focuslab.pk/): a numbered feed of what we are building, reading, and thinking about.
- [Studio](https://focuslab.pk/studio/): who we are and how we work.
- [Stack](https://focuslab.pk/stack/): the tools we build with, including AI.
- [Thoughts](https://focuslab.pk/thoughts/): writing we find useful (curated, external).
- [Podcast](https://focuslab.pk/podcast/): podcasts we find useful (curated, external).
- [Books](https://focuslab.pk/books/): the shelf that shaped how we build.
- [Jobs](https://focuslab.pk/jobs/): working at Focus Lab.
- [Policies](https://focuslab.pk/policies/): terms, privacy, and the rest.
- [Contact](https://focuslab.pk/contact/): start a conversation.

## The stream

The home page is a numbered feed served at `/00`, `/01`, `/02`, … Each entry is
self-contained and is one of five kinds:

- `note` — a short thought or update from the studio
- `launch` — something we shipped
- `link` — a link worth sharing
- `quote` — a line worth keeping
- `essay` — a piece of writing we found useful (curated, with a source + link)

Curated entries (`essay`, `quote`, `link`) always carry a `source` and a `url`
to the original. Nothing curated is presented as ours.

## Adding content (for LLMs and agents)

All content lives in typed data files under `src/data/`. To add content, edit
the relevant file and follow its exported TypeScript interface:

- New stream entry → append to `stream` in `src/data/stream.ts`
- New product → add to `products` in `src/data/products.ts`
- New book → add to `books` in `src/data/books.ts`
- New curated essay → add to `thoughts` in `src/data/thoughts.ts`
- New curated show → add to `podcasts` in `src/data/podcast.ts`
- New policy → add to `policies` in `src/data/policies.ts`

Full schema, conventions, and examples: see `docs/CONTENT.md` in the repository.

## Notes

- Background colour is a random shade of green per page load; `/NN` pages use a
  deterministic shade per entry.
- External curated links are always attributed to their source.
